decisions.reason: As a recently launched line extension close to the core drainage range, it fits the firm's design-and-engineering positioning and is likely to be retained because investment and public commitment are already in place.
This shower channel sits squarely in the firm's core business and its dedicated web presentation signals visible commitment, which makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.

Although more specialized, the pump-assisted drainage line builds directly on the firm's established know-how and future-ready bathroom strategy, so management is likely to give it more time rather than abandon it quickly.
The tileable floor drain is close to the firm's established offer and was prominently presented, so escalation of commitment and strategic fit both point to keeping it on the market.

This design grate complements the existing drainage portfolio and supports the firm's aesthetics-led value proposition, making near-term withdrawal relatively unlikely despite being easier to rationalize than a core system product.
